info.name: Macrometa API Reference Activity Metrics System API
Check the health of the service

items.docs: Gets the health of the FaaS service. This API returns HTTP status 200 OK if the service is running, otherwise it returns a 500 Internal Server Error.

info.name: Check the readiness of the service

items.docs: Gets the readiness of the FaaS service. This API returns HTTP status 200 OK if the service is able to handle requests, otherwise it returns a 503 Service Unavailable.
Gets the current version of the service.
